summary: Join our call center customer service skills training course to learn effective communication techniques and improve your service quality. Enroll today!
lede: Call center training helps experienced agents, supervisors, and quality analysts manage customer interactions and review service performance. Participants practice diagnosing customer intent, guiding conversations, handling and escalating complaints, and documenting cases in CRM systems. They also develop quality evaluation and coaching routines, calculate measures such as customer satisfaction and first contact resolution, and use service data to identify improvement priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for experienced service professionals who manage customer interactions, review service evidence, coach frontline teams, or oversee call center performance.
modules: Call Center Customer Service Skills Foundations
prerequisites: This intermediate-to-advanced course suits professionals with practical experience in customer service, contact center operations, quality assurance, complaint handling, workforce planning, or team supervision. You should recognize common measures such as CSAT, FCR, and AHT and have basic spreadsheet skills. Coding requirement: none. Advanced AI and speech analytics concepts receive conceptual awareness and operational application coverage rather than technical engineering treatment.
